test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can replace the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The __incorrigible__ optimism displayed by Aishwarya in difficult situations turned out her to be a favourite among her friends.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unchanged**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Incorrigible **means incapable of being corrected, reformed, or improved. (सुधार किये जाने में असमर्थ)

 
 
• **Example**: *Despite numerous interventions and counselling sessions, his incorrigible behaviour continued.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Unchanged **means not altered, modified, or varied; remaining the same over a period of time. (परिवर्तित, संशोधित या विविध नहीं; कुछ समय तक वही बना रहता है)
 
 
• **Example**: *The landscape remained unchanged for decades.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Translucent: **Allowing light to pass through, but diffusing it to the extent that objects on the other side are not clearly visible. (प्रकाश को गुजरने देना, लेकिन उसे इस हद तक फैलाना कि दूसरी तरफ की वस्तुएं स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाई न दें)
 
• **Illustrious: **Well-known, famous, and highly distinguished, often due to outstanding achievements. (प्रसिद्ध, प्रसिद्ध और अत्यधिक प्रतिष्ठित, अक्सर उत्कृष्ट उपलब्धियों के कारण)
 
• **Barefoot: **Without shoes or any covering on the feet. (पैरों में जूते या कोई आवरण नहीं)

47:T72c,
The correct answer is: **Becoming**
